items.title: Eat Dog Food
items.detail: Use the Weenie Wagon at your C.A.M.P. or another player's camp

items.title: Build a Heavy Cryo Turret in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Unlocked at rank 65 of Season 12 scoreboard; use re-roll if unavailable

items.title: Collect a Teapot
items.detail: Palace of the Winding Path has several on tables in the main building

items.title: Kill a Wendigo
items.detail: Vault 51 in the Forest has reliable spawns in the Atrium area

items.title: Kill an Enemy in the Forest Region
items.detail: Point Pleasant has a dense concentration of Cultists

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Antiseptic
items.detail: Kill Ticks at Big B's Rest Stop shack west of the location

items.title: Take a Camera Picture of a Radscorpion
items.detail: Hocking Hills Little League Field has Burning Radscorpions near the baseball diamond

items.title: Collect Caps
items.detail: Sell looted weapons, junk, chems, or food to vendors at train stations

items.title: Collect a Garden Gnome
items.detail: The General's Steakhouse in the Mire has 5-8 gnomes in the walled garden and shed

items.title: Complete Daily Operations on a Public Team!
items.detail: Join or start a Daily Ops public team and complete the operation

items.title: Complete a Grunt Hunt
items.detail: Use the Bounty Board at The Last Resort saloon in Highway Town

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: RobCo Research Center has dependable robot spawns; use energy weapons

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Silva Homestead in the Forest has plants or plant several at your C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while wearing a Costume
items.detail: Pint-Sized Phantoms spawn at cabins and campgrounds during the Slasher event; equip any costume piece

items.title: Kill a Scorched
items.detail: Wavy Willard's Water Park in the Toxic Valley has many Scorched; target the head in V.A.T.S.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Aluminum
items.detail: Craft Bulk Aluminum at a Tinker's Workbench then scrap it

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Complete all six other daily challenges on three separate days during the week

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Build a C.A.M.P. or Shelter inspired by slasher movies and submit entries for a chance to win Atoms and exclusive titles.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Hunt Scorched creatures for seasonal rewards including new cosmetics and collectibles.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Earn double experience points and progress on the Scoreboard at an accelerated rate.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chances to catch seasonal fish with new recipes and challenges available.
